This role will own the go-to-market approach for Creator exclusives, partnering across Content, Creator, Marketing, Growth, Social, PR and other teams to build campaigns that effectively bring a creator's fans to Tubi and introduce creators to new viewers among Tubi’s 110 million monthly active users. This role will help us understand what actually works—developing learning agendas, evaluating performance, designing experiments and translating those insights into stronger marketing strategies across the portfolio. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategic marketer, analytical thinker and builder. They know how to turn a title into a compelling audience proposition, understand the unique role creators can play in driving discovery and fandom, and are energized by creating new playbooks rather than simply applying old ones. This is a hybrid role based out of our Los Angeles office. You must be willing to travel to our Los Angeles office 2-3 days/week. What You'll Do: Lead go-to-market strategy for Tubi’s exclusive Creator titles, developing audience-first marketing plans that define positioning, target audiences, channel strategy, creator fandom activation and launch approach. jobs.description_text: About the Role: Tubi is looking for a Senior Manager, Publicity to help lead publicity across our distinct slate of Tubi Originals, including movies, series, and creator-led content. We’re looking for an experienced entertainment publicist who knows the traditional publicity playbook inside and out … and who also knows when to throw it out and start from scratch. The ideal candidate will develop earned strategies that turn titles, talent and creators into cultural moments, finding the story, audience insight or unexpected idea that can make something travel well beyond a traditional launch cycle. This person should be equally credible in a room with talent and their representatives, on the ground at a major industry event, and around a table developing an unconventional idea designed to get fans talking and press reporting. The right candidate has deep entertainment relationships and excellent talent instincts, but their view of publicity extends beyond junkets, premieres, and red carpets. They are curious about creators, fandoms, internet culture, and the new places and people shaping entertainment conversation. They will work closely with teams across Content, Creator, Integrated Marketing, and International, as well as talent, creators, representatives, producers, and external agency partners. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.
